text.pre: Q05、部落關係達標（光做主線就夠）
text.preEn: Q05, enough village ties (the main story is enough)

steps.text: 族男請男性長輩教他造船
steps.textEn: The Tao man asks the man elder to teach him boat building

lines.zh: 我想學造船。可以跟著您學嗎？
lines.en: I want to learn to build boats. May I learn from you?

lines.zh: 造船不是一天的事，要從認識樹開始，要有耐心。
lines.en: Building a boat takes more than a day. It starts with knowing the trees. You need patience.

lines.zh: 先跟我在近海練習划船，把手練穩。
lines.en: First, practise paddling with me near the shore to steady your hands.

toast: 男性長輩答應教族男造船。
toastEn: The man elder agreed to teach the Tao man boat building.

hint.zh: 部落的人都認識族男了，他可以請男性長輩教他造船。
hint.en: The village knows the Tao man now. He can ask the man elder to teach him boat building.

review: 拜師學造船的說法（向誰拜師、怎麼開口）請族人確認

name.en: Practise near the shore with the elder

steps.text: 族男跟長輩在港邊近海練習划拼板舟
steps.textEn: The Tao man practises paddling a plank boat near the harbour with the elder

lines.zh: 槳要一起下水，船才不會晃。眼睛看浪，不要看槳。
lines.en: Put the paddles in together so the boat doesn't rock. Watch the waves, not the paddle.

lines.zh: 好像比較穩了。
lines.en: It feels steadier now.

steps.text: 回岸上聽長輩說
steps.textEn: Back on shore, listen to the elder

lines.zh: 手穩多了。下次帶你上山看樹。
lines.en: Your hands are much steadier. Next time I'll take you up the mountain to see the trees.

toast: 族男可以在近海划拼板舟了。
toastEn: The Tao man can now paddle a plank boat near the shore.

hint.zh: 拜師之後，男性長輩會帶族男在近海練習。
hint.en: After becoming an apprentice, the man elder will take the Tao man to practise near the shore.

name.en: Learn the boat-building trees on the mountain

text.whoEn: Tao man; the traveller may watch
text.coop: 族男可單人；旅人參觀要雙人：族男＋旅人
text.coopEn: The Tao man can go alone; for the traveller to watch, a pair: Tao man + Traveller

steps.text: 族男跟長輩上山認識造舟的樹
steps.textEn: The Tao man goes up the mountain with the elder to learn the boat-building trees

lines.zh: 做船的樹，要長在對的地方，也要問過樹的主人家。
lines.en: A tree for a boat has to grow in the right place, and you must ask the family that owns it.

lines.zh: 每一種木頭放在船的不同位置。樹的名字，以後族人會教你。
lines.en: Each kind of wood goes in a different part of the boat. The Tao people will teach you the tree names later.

lines.zh: 我記下樹皮和葉子的樣子了。
lines.en: I've noted what the bark and leaves look like.

steps.text: 下山後向長輩回報
steps.textEn: Report to the elder after coming down

lines.zh: 認得樹，船才造得好。等木材乾了，就可以拼板。
lines.en: Know your trees and you'll build a good boat. Once the timber is dry, we can join the planks.

toast: 族男認識了造船用的樹。
toastEn: The Tao man learned the trees used for building boats.

hint.zh: 不是飛魚季的時候，男性長輩會帶族男上大森山看樹。
hint.en: Outside flying fish season, the man elder will take the Tao man up Mt. Dasen to see the trees.

review: 造舟樹種、上山砍樹的規矩（樹的主人、時間）請族人確認；樹的族語名稱暫不列出

steps.text: 男性長輩說：可以開始拼板了
steps.textEn: The man elder says: time to start joining the planks

lines.zh: 木材乾了，可以開始了。拼板要慢，一塊錯了整條船都會漏水。
lines.en: The timber is dry. We can begin. Go slowly with the planks — one wrong board and the whole boat leaks.

steps.text: 族男在家旁一塊一塊拼起船板，用木釘固定
steps.textEn: Beside the house, the Tao man joins the boat planks one by one and fixes them with wooden pegs

lines.zh: 這塊對齊了……再下一塊。
lines.en: This one's lined up… now the next.

steps.text: 族男在船身塗上紅、白、黑三色
steps.textEn: The Tao man paints the hull red, white and black

lines.zh: 顏色跟家裡長輩教的一樣。
lines.en: The colours are just as the elders at home taught.

lines.zh: 船身的紋樣屬於每一個家族，遊戲只呈現簡單的顏色。
lines.en: Hull patterns belong to each family. The game only shows simple colours.

steps.text: 請男性長輩看看新船
steps.textEn: Ask the man elder to look at the new boat

lines.zh: 這是你的船了。照顧它，就像照顧家人。
lines.en: This is your boat now. Look after it like you look after family.

toast: 族男完成了自己的拼板舟。
toastEn: The Tao man finished his own plank boat.

hint.zh: 認識造舟的樹之後，族男可以開始拼板造船。
hint.en: After learning the boat-building trees, the Tao man can start building the plank boat.

review: 拼板造船的過程（多人合作、需時多久）在遊戲中大幅簡化；船身紋樣屬於家族，請族人確認可呈現的程度

name.zh: 新船下水的芋頭（選用，整段待確認）
name.en: Taro for the new boat's launch (optional, whole part to be confirmed)

text.who: 族男、族女；旅人須受主人邀請
text.whoEn: Tao man, Tao woman; the traveller only if invited by the host
text.coopEn: Trio: Tao man + Tao woman + Traveller

steps.text: 女性長輩和族女準備新船下水要用的芋頭
steps.textEn: The woman elder and the Tao woman prepare taro for the new boat's launch

lines.zh: 新船下水，家裡要準備芋頭。這幾顆挑好了，妳拿著。
lines.en: When a new boat is launched, the family prepares taro. I've picked these — you hold them.

steps.text: 主人家長輩邀請旅人一起去
steps.textEn: The host family elder invites the traveller along

lines.zh: 新船下水，你也是我們家的朋友，一起來。站在後面看就好，不要拍照。
lines.en: The new boat is being launched, and you're a friend of our family. Come with us. Just watch from the back, and no photos.

lines.zh: 謝謝您邀請我。我會站遠一點，不拍照。
lines.en: Thank you for inviting me. I'll stand back and won't take photos.

steps.text: 全隊在岸邊，看新船下水
steps.textEn: The whole party watches the new boat launch from the shore

lines.zh: 新船下水的儀式由家族和船組進行，遊戲不呈現儀式本身。
lines.en: The new boat's launch ceremony is done by the family and the crew. The game doesn't show the ceremony itself.

lines.zh: （小聲）船好漂亮。
lines.en: (quietly) What a beautiful boat.

toast: 全家和朋友一起，迎接新的拼板舟。
toastEn: Family and friends together welcome the new plank boat.

hint.zh: 族男的新船完成了，下水前家裡要準備芋頭，也會邀請旅人。
hint.en: The Tao man's new boat is finished. Before the launch, the family prepares taro and will invite the traveller.

review: 新船下水時的芋頭與邀請（整段待確認）：遊戲只呈現準備芋頭與受邀觀禮，不呈現儀式本身

name.en: Catch flying fish in your own boat

text.unlockEn: Another source of flying fish, T7

steps.text: 族男向男性長輩報告：要駕自己的船出海
steps.textEn: The Tao man tells the man elder: he's taking his own boat to sea

lines.zh: 第一次駕自己的船，不要逞強。看不準就回來。
lines.en: First time in your own boat — don't push yourself. If you can't judge it, come back.

lines.zh: 出海期間只能操控族男。捕到魚，或按「放棄出海」，才會回岸邊和大家會合。
lines.en: While at sea, you can only control the Tao man. Catch a fish, or tap "Give up", to return to shore and rejoin everyone.

solo.taskEn: Catch flying fish in your own boat

giveUp.en: The waves are too big today. Back to shore.
Safety first. Try again next time.

steps.text: 族男划自己的拼板舟出海捕飛魚
steps.textEn: The Tao man paddles his own plank boat out for flying fish

lines.zh: 捕到了！自己的船，自己的魚。
lines.en: Caught one! My own boat, my own fish.

steps.text: 族男回到岸邊，和族女、旅人會合
steps.textEn: The Tao man returns to shore and meets up with the Tao woman and the traveller

lines.zh: 回來了！自己的船划得好穩。
lines.en: You're back! Your own boat paddles so steady.

lines.zh: 我們在岸邊一直看著。
lines.en: We were watching from the shore the whole time.

steps.text: 向男性長輩回報
steps.textEn: Report to the man elder

lines.zh: 你的船，第一次帶魚回家。好。
lines.en: Your boat's first time bringing fish home. Good.

toast: 族男駕自己的船捕到飛魚。
toastEn: The Tao man caught flying fish in his own boat.

hint.zh: 飛魚季時，族男可以駕自己的拼板舟出海。
hint.en: In flying fish season, the Tao man can take his own plank boat to sea.

name.en: Night torch fishing for flying fish (big boat)

steps.text: 晚上，男性長輩找族男加入大船船組
steps.textEn: At night, the man elder asks the Tao man to join the big-boat crew

lines.zh: 今晚大船（cinedkeran）出海，用火把招飛魚。你跟著船組，聽船長的話。
lines.en: Tonight the big boat (cinedkeran) goes out to call flying fish with torches. Go with the crew and listen to the captain.

lines.zh: 出海期間只能操控族男。
lines.en: While at sea, you can only control the Tao man.

solo.taskEn: at sea with the big-boat crew at night

giveUp.en: The waves are too big today. Back to shore.
Safety first. Try again next time.

steps.text: 族男跟大船船組在夜裡出海，火光下撈飛魚
steps.textEn: The Tao man goes out at night with the big-boat crew and scoops flying fish by torchlight

lines.zh: 火把一亮，飛魚就跳過來了！
lines.en: The moment the torch lights up, the flying fish jump right over!

lines.zh: 大家一起划，一起撈。
lines.en: Everyone paddles together and scoops together.

steps.text: 天快亮時回到岸邊，和大家會合
steps.textEn: Return to shore near dawn and meet up with everyone

lines.zh: 回來了，平安就好。
lines.en: You're back. As long as you're safe.

steps.text: 向男性長輩回報
steps.textEn: Report to the man elder

lines.zh: 跟大船出過海，你就是船組的人了。
lines.en: Now that you've been out with the big boat, you're one of the crew.

toast: 族男學會在大船上合作。
toastEn: The Tao man learned to work together on the big boat.

hint.zh: 飛魚季的晚上，大船會用火把出海，男性長輩可能會找族男。
hint.en: On flying fish season nights, the big boat goes out with torches. The man elder may come looking for the Tao man.

review: 夜間大船火炬捕飛魚：時間（飛魚季初期）、船組組成與禁忌請族人確認

name.zh: 小蘭嶼（整段待族人同意）
name.en: Little Orchid Island (whole part awaits community approval)

steps.text: 男性長輩說起小蘭嶼
steps.textEn: The man elder talks about Little Orchid Island

lines.zh: Jimagaod 是我們很重要的漁場。海流急，要很慎重，只有男人去。
lines.en: Jimagaod is a very important fishing ground for us. The currents are strong, so we're very careful. Only men go.

lines.zh: 今天跟著我，划到附近看看。不上岸，看完就回來。
lines.en: Come with me today and paddle close to have a look. We won't land. We'll look and come back.

solo.taskEn: paddling toward Little Orchid Island with the elder

giveUp.en: The waves are too big today. Back to shore.
Safety first. Try again next time.

steps.text: 族男跟長輩划拼板舟，遠遠看著小蘭嶼
steps.textEn: The Tao man paddles a plank boat with the elder and looks at Little Orchid Island from afar

lines.zh: 島越來越近了……浪也越來越大。
lines.en: The island is getting closer… and the waves are getting bigger.

lines.zh: 就到這裡。記住它的樣子，我們回去。
lines.en: This is far enough. Remember how it looks. We're going back.

steps.text: 回到岸邊，和大家會合
steps.textEn: Return to shore and meet up with everyone

lines.zh: 你們去好久！海上怎麼樣？
lines.en: You were gone so long! How was it out there?

lines.zh: ……下次再慢慢說。
lines.en: …I'll tell you about it slowly, another time.

steps.text: 向男性長輩回報
steps.textEn: Report to the man elder

lines.zh: 那邊的故事，等你再大一點，我再告訴你。
lines.en: The stories from over there — I'll tell you when you're a bit older.

toast: 族男遠遠看過了小蘭嶼。
toastEn: The Tao man has seen Little Orchid Island from afar.

hint.zh: 有了自己的船之後，男性長輩望著南邊的海，好像想起什麼。
hint.en: Once the Tao man has his own boat, the man elder gazes at the sea to the south, as if remembering something.

review: 小蘭嶼（Jimagaod）的整段內容待族人同意：目前只呈現族男跟長輩划到附近的漁場、不登島
